columns.description: Expense Description published for admin spend above £25,000 only

d010ad1b3aa96922fec0834183b8824882bd2c97.notes: Used the recorded row-0 header, which gives clean full column names. But sample_rows show, right after it, a month-label line ('Apr-12', mostly blank) and then a second, messier repeated header line ('Supplier Name\n', 'Amount ', 'Expenses Type \n' appearing twice, trailing newlines) before real data resumes at 'DFID, DFID, 11/04/2012...'. This looks like a file made by concatenating monthly export blocks, each carrying its own divider/header lines as literal rows. A naive header_row=0 read will pull in these divider and repeated-header rows as fake data throughout the file (this pattern likely repeats every month) — reviewer/build step must filter out embedded label and header-repeat rows before loading. 'description' is only populated for admin spend above £25,000, so it will be sparse/mostly empty. Review: April-September 2012 blocks map cleanly (11,472 rows); later blocks in the same file change header layout and are held (10,624 rows), reported on the page. A second mapping for those blocks is future work. Review: three block layouts in one file (Apr-Nov 'Supplier Name/Amount/Expenses…', then Dec onward reordered 'Date/Expense Type/Expense Area/Supplier/Transaction Number/Amount'); alt_columns covers them.

861e2c9c6d8bb61f42705e951014e843ddc72569.notes: 'Allocation Date' is the only date column available; mapped to payment_date but it may represent an allocation/posting date rather than the actual payment date — reviewer should confirm. Review: preview inspected; dates, suppliers and amounts read as published.

efcc2066e9e9bccd5a9090f2a29258f78438e51e.notes: 'amount' appears to be the net (pre-VAT) figure — sample rows show a separate 'vat' column at ~20% of 'amount' (e.g. amount 1960.0, vat 392.0). 'vat' and 'vat_code' are not mapped, per the rule against folding VAT into amount_gbp. 'beneficiary' is sometimes 'Redacted' in the sample rows; kept as published. Review: preview inspected; dates, suppliers and amounts read as published.

constants.body: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

ffd3fc6de9870257e508be06f0df0e321d25bd2c.notes: Clean, single-header table; no issues noted. Review: preview inspected; dates, suppliers and amounts read as published.

46021c3a321f8028f71c5fec241aa007db9218e9.notes: Table also carries 'Organisational unit' (a directorate-level field, e.g. 'People Directorate') and 'Expenditure category' (a broader category than 'Detailed Expenses type', e.g. 'Supplies and Services') — only one column each is allowed for expense_area/expense_type, so these two were left unmapped; reviewer should check whether they'd be preferred over 'Service label'/'Detailed Expenses type'. 'Capital/\nRevenue' and 'Supplier ID' also unmapped, no schema slot for them. Review: preview inspected; dates, suppliers and amounts read as published.

1290aae1e6a8cbfa60bc8d47c56780709231061e.reject: Every sample row has 'Supplier Name' populated as 'BARCLAYCARD PROCUREMENT CARD' with the same 'Voucher' number, split across many small (including negative) amounts by expense type/area — this is a procurement-card (GPC) statement broken out by spend category, not supplier-level payment lines.

fd8703927e1188f4c68987c641e496ca9df08f85.notes: Minimal 3-column table (Supplier, Payment Date, Amount only); no expense_area/expense_type/reference/description/period available. Review: preview inspected; dates, suppliers and amounts read as published.

f7364e529c276bf35e6c9b19cda7baba4f8448fd.notes: Minimal 3-column table (Supplier, Payment Date, Amount only), same shape as the other Greenwich source in this family; no expense_area/expense_type/reference/description/period available. Review: preview inspected; dates, suppliers and amounts read as published.

adf25f9f31269c417f96ee00c75c837896bdbbdb.notes: File starts with a title line ('Wales Office spend over £500', 'May-10' ...) at row 0, a blank row at row 1, then the real header (ENTITY, EXPENSE_AREA, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_NUMBER, SUPPLIER_NAME, INVOICE_AMOUNT, NAC_DESCRIPTION, Service provided) at row 2 — header_row set to 2 accordingly. Reviewer should confirm the blank-row count is consistent for other months' files in this same series if more get added later. Review: 17 of 23 rows have no date in the source; kept with payment_date null.

096c8c488b60488acea2a888e215be9ea43aff19.notes: File starts with a title line ('Payments for Publishing for Invoices paid between 01-SEP-2022 and 30-SEP-2022') at row 0, real header at row 1 — header_row set to 1 accordingly. Note the exact header text for payment_date and expense_area carries a leading space (' Paid Date', ' Department') in the source. 'Cost Centre' holds a code (e.g. 'D2510'), not a text description, but it is the only expense-type-like field available; reviewer should sanity-check this choice. 'Irrecoverable VAT' is present but not mapped to amount_gbp, per the rule against folding VAT into the payment amount. Review: expense_type is the council's cost-centre code, as published.

constants.body: Department of Energy and Climate Change

a670f04716a86dd5b4cbe201b65dd7c85880766a.notes: Threshold 500 taken from the title ('Spend over £500 in the Department of Energy and Climate Change'). Clean single-header table, no title/divider rows in the sample. No period or description column present. Review: a £289m line is real central-government spend; the family's amount cap was raised to £5bn.

3ef6586edd03fb6c63b21861f171ee3ec7a681d4.notes: Threshold 500 taken from the title ('Spend over £500 in Government Equalities Office'). Small file (16 rows in sample count), clean single header. One sample row is a large grant-in-aid payment to another body (EHRC) rather than a commercial supplier — kept as published per the rule that supplier names are published text. Review: 16 rows, no dates in the source.

constants.body: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

cad03d565abbb431d95bde21a877f6716a06d94b.notes: Threshold 500 taken from the title ('Spend over £500 in the Government Offices for the Regions'). Same column shape and same publisher string as the DCLG source already mapped in this file (job d010... no, job ffd3fc6d...); body taken from this source entry's own 'publisher' field, which is the modern successor department, not 'Government Offices for the Regions' itself. Clean single header, no issues. Review: Government Offices for the Regions return, published under the successor department's name.

45e5c4b154f37f9657e1533c3cea960c4d928d92.notes: Threshold 500 taken from the title ('Expenditure over £500'). Only 'invoice_date' is available — there is no separate payment-date column, so payment_date is mapped to invoice date; reviewer should confirm this is acceptable given the schema's stated preference for payment over invoice date. Column is named 'net_amount' but no VAT column appears anywhere in this table's header, so it is mapped as the published amount as-is (not adjusted); reviewer should double check whether 'net' implies VAT was stripped out elsewhere. Many sample suppliers are '*Redact - Personal Information' — kept as published (redaction is the publisher's own text, not something applied here). Negative amounts (credits) appear in samples and are kept with sign preserved. Review: only an invoice date exists; payment_date carries it. net_amount as published, no VAT column.

constants.body: UK Commission for Employment and Skills

e26bf628169d3aecf4e1052362a421c16a630da8.notes: Threshold 500 taken from the title ('Spend over £500 in the UK Commission for Employment and Skills'). 'Date' includes a literal time component in the sample ('10/01/2014 00:00') — always midnight in samples shown, so date extraction should be safe, but reviewer should confirm. No expense_area-equivalent column exists (only department-level 'Department Family'/'Entity'), so left unmapped. Table also carries 'Year' and 'Period' columns, but sample values ('C', '12') don't read as a clean, publishable period label, so 'period' was left unmapped — reviewer should check what these encode before adding. 'Supplier' values carry an embedded supplier code prefix (e.g. 'ASP002 - Aspero Limited') — kept exactly as published, not split apart. Not mapped, no schema slot: Supplier postcode, Supplier type, HOME_CREDIT, HOME_DEBIT, Contract Number, Project Code, Expenditure type. Review: no dates or expense area in the source; Year/Period columns opaque and left unmapped.

cf8fc911f167104ad7bf020b78493813d2ad0eb8.notes: Threshold 500 taken from the title ('Administrative spend over £500 in UK Trade and Investment'); note the title scopes this file to administrative spend only, not the department's full spend-over-£500 return — reviewer should check whether a separate 'programme spend' file exists for the same body/period that would need its own mapping. 'Description' is empty in every sample row, likely sparse throughout. Sample suppliers include 'Personal Expense, Name Witheld' (employee expense claims) — kept as published per the rule on personal names published under the transparency code. Review: administrative spend only; lines below £500 kept as published.
